name: Higgsfield
verdict: No OAuth was confirmed: you create an API key ID and secret in the console with billing added, in about 1-3 days. For CLI or MCP use, end users sign in with their own account and credits.
needGuide: No — create a key in the Higgsfield console and add billing.

auth.detail: The REST API uses a project-scoped key ID and secret: `Authorization: Key <KEY_ID>:<KEY_SECRET>`, created in the Higgsfield console. The CLI (`npm i -g @higgsfield/cli`) signs in with `higgsfield auth login` in a browser and its tokens are short-lived. The MCP server (https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp) says 'no API keys', so likely browser OAuth sign-in (unconfirmed). No developer-registered OAuth app is documented.

approval.gate: None documented. API is pay-per-generation. The page mentions business-email verification and adding a card with a $15 balance for launch pricing. Each new key starts at 20 concurrent requests.

scopes.why: No scope model documented; keys are per project.
scopes.summary: No scope model documented. Keys are per project; CLI/MCP act as the signed-in user with access to their credits and generations.

cost: API is pay-per-use (e.g. $0.04/image for one model; volume discounts). CLI/MCP spend credits from the user's Higgsfield plan.
prerequisites: Account and owner: Whoever owns the Higgsfield workspace and billing, on a company account (the CLI has a `workspace` command to select the billing workspace).
Where you register: Higgsfield Console (also open.higgsfield.ai) → API keys → create a key ID/secret per project; exact menu names not documented.
Cost: API is pay-per-use (e.g. $0.04/image for one model; volume discounts). CLI/MCP spend credits from the user's Higgsfield plan.

registerAt.path: Higgsfield Console (also open.higgsfield.ai) → API keys → create a key ID/secret per project; exact menu names not documented.

steps.do: Create a Higgsfield account with a company email and open console.higgsfield.ai.
Add billing (card and balance) and verify the business email if you want the launch discount.
Create an API key ID and secret for a project and store them as HF_API_KEY_ID and HF_API_KEY_SECRET on your server.
POST to a model endpoint such as api.higgsfield.ai/<model>/<mode> with the Key header, then poll status_url until done.
For agent use install the CLI and run `higgsfield auth login`, or connect the MCP server from your client.
Add spend limits, cancellation via cancel_url, and per-customer cost tracking.

roles.team: Whoever owns the Higgsfield workspace and billing, on a company account (the CLI has a `workspace` command to select the billing workspace).
roles.console: none documented (keys are per project and can be rotated or revoked)
roles.customer: For CLI/MCP use, the end user signs in with their own Higgsfield account and uses their own credits. Customer admin controls are not documented.

testing: Free-tier or credit availability is not stated.
Use `higgsfield generate cost-estimate` to check cost before generating, and poll the status_url for jobs.

blockers.problem: No third-party OAuth, so customers cannot connect through your app
blockers.fix: Use your own API key and bill customers, or have them use the CLI/MCP themselves.
Handle 'Session expired' by re-running auth login.

blockers.problem: Generation costs vary by model and resolution
blockers.fix: Estimate cost before each call and set spend caps.

automation.agentCan: Write the generation client, install and script the CLI, poll jobs, estimate costs, and draft prompts and usage docs.
automation.humanMust: Sign in (including browser login), add payment, verify the business email, and approve spend.

uncertain: Whether the MCP server uses OAuth, console menu paths, free credits, rate limits beyond 20 concurrent, and whether Higgsfield offers partner OAuth were not confirmed.
